topic: Clean Architecture, SOLID Principles, and Design Patterns
learningObjectives: Separate application responsibilities into maintainable layers.
Apply SOLID principles to improve Python code design.
Select suitable design patterns for common software problems.

activities.title: Clean Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Explore the responsibilities of each application layer.

content.concept: Clean Architecture separates core business rules from application orchestration, external interfaces, frameworks, and infrastructure concerns.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Contains core business rules and domain concepts that should be independent of external technology.
Contains application-specific business workflows and coordinates domain operations.
Converts data between external formats and the application or domain models.
Contains frameworks, databases, web servers, external services, and other implementation details.

activities.title: SOLID Principle Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the SOLID principle that best matches the scenario.

content.concept: SOLID principles address different design concerns, such as focused responsibilities, extensibility, substitutability, smaller interfaces, and dependency direction.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Layer Builder
activities.instruction: Assemble the major layers of a maintainable Python application.

content.concept: Separating domain logic, application services, interfaces, and infrastructure makes components easier to test, replace, and maintain.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Design Pattern Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the pattern that best fits the described problem.

content.concept: Design patterns provide reusable structures for recurring design problems. The appropriate choice depends on the problem rather than on the programming language alone.
